policy.statement: All reviewed RustSec advisories remain OPEN. Exact-source local-path glib 0.18.5 may disappear from cargo-audit's registry warning output without proving remediation. The checked Cargo.lock override and complete backport source-custody verifier must pass; all other warnings must match exactly, and any vulnerability, new warning, missing other warning or dependency drift fails closed. No advisory is waived or marked fixed.

advisories.review_note: The reviewed stable Linux desktop dependency graph resolves Tauri through GTK 0.18 and glib 0.18.5. Motionwright does not call VariantStrIter directly. This reduces direct exposure but does not resolve the upstream unsoundness.
recheck_when: the stable Tauri Linux stack supports a non-vulnerable glib line
the advisory scope or severity changes
first-party code begins using the affected API

advisories.review_note: New 2026-06-28 upstream maintenance warning, not a reported vulnerability or security fix. The exact registry bytes are locked, and Cargo.lock contains two declared dependency routes (Manim direct and Semwright Motion Canvas via the service); deployed runtime reachability remains unverified. This review tracks an OPEN risk, not a safety waiver, not replacement by skrifa, and not product G2/G3 clearance.
recheck_when: ttf-parser registry source/checksum or locked version changes
direct or transitive Cargo.lock owner closure changes
the selected Semwright Motion Canvas driver source revision changes
the RustSec classification or reachable font parsing behavior changes
an actively maintained parser is adopted and verified in the affected producers

advisories.review_note: The unmaintained proc-macro crate is transitive through the GTK 0.18 macro stack. It is a maintenance warning rather than a claimed vulnerability fix.
recheck_when: the stable Tauri/GTK dependency graph removes proc-macro-error
